description: Today's API price for one or more large language models, in US dollars per million tokens, with cached and batch prices, context window and the date the prices were checked. Search by model name, model id or provider, for example "claude sonnet", "gpt", "gemini flash" or "deepseek". Prices are refreshed every morning.

limit.description: How many models to return, 1 to 25. Default 8.

query.description: Model name, model id or provider to search for.

name: llm_price_lookup
title: Look up LLM API prices
